name: BackMeUp
summary: SW Sydney dialup + web-hosting ISP ('since 1996', unlimited $29.95/mo inc GST); retail site gone by 2006, operating company cancelled 4 Sep 2007 (BMU PTY. LIMITED, ACN 082 921 248); backmeup.net.au later reused for an unrelated 'Backme Up' online-backup service (to ~2014).

events.details: Sydney dialup ISP, a division of BMU Pty Limited (ACN 082 921 248); site meta reads 'Internet Service Provider based in Sydney, Australia since 1996'; earliest Wayback capture 31 Mar 1997.

Retail dialup/hosting page last captured Jan 2003 ($29.95/mo inc GST); 302 redirect by Feb 2004; 'This site has been removed' by Aug 2006. Operating company BMU Pty Limited (ACN 082 921 248) cancelled 4 Sep 2007.
backmeup.net.au later reused for an unrelated 'Backme Up' online-backup service (captured 2013-2014); not the dialup ISP.
